mods.title: Stalker Weapon Pack v3.7
mods.description: This pack includes a huge number of fixes, from animation settings to a complete redesign of configs. We did not touch weapon stats, balance, or similar aspects — only the most critical bugs. The pack is far from perfect, but we tried to make it playable. The game is fully compatible with all weather mods, except Atmosfear 3.
